board.editing_hint: Drag a column by its handle to reorder it. Double-click a name to rename it, or use ⋯ for color, behavior and delete. Changes save right away.

head.rename_title: Double-click or press Enter to rename
head.grip_hint: Press Space to pick the column up, the arrow keys to move it and Space again to drop it. Escape puts it back. {alt} with the left or right arrow moves it one step.

menu.delete_initial: New tasks start here. Make another column the start to delete this one.

rename.label: Column name
rename.empty: A column needs a name. The old one stays.

add.name: New column
add.hint: Press Enter to add it, Escape to cancel.
add.required: Type a name for the column.

behavior.title: Behavior of {column}
behavior.lead: Changes save as you make them and apply to this board only.
behavior.wip_desc: The board's counters at the top add up the tasks in columns marked here.

flags.initial_desc: New tasks land in this column, and a task with unfinished dependencies waits here.
flags.terminal_desc: Tasks in this column count as done and unblock the tasks that depend on them.
flags.auto_advance: Move on when the agent finishes
flags.auto_advance_desc: When the agent's run ends cleanly, the task moves to the next column on its own.
flags.push_branch_desc: A clean run here pushes the task's branch to the repository.
flags.open_pr_desc: A task entering this column opens its pull request.
flags.legacy_desc: Any approval on the task keeps it here, not only the required ones. Turn it off to rely on required approvals.
flags.no_agents: No agent covers this column yet.
flags.agent_verdict: The agent decides where the task goes
flags.agent_verdict_desc: The agent's verdict moves the task on, or sends it back to the column the verdict names.
flags.lock_tests_desc: The tests a clean run here writes are locked. If a later column changes one, the task waits there until a person approves the change.
flags.pr_draft: Open the pull request as a draft
flags.pr_draft_desc: A task entering this column opens its pull request as a draft, so the project's CI runs before anyone reviews it.
flags.pr_ready_desc: A task entering this column takes its pull request out of draft so it can be reviewed.
flags.merge_target_desc: When the task's pull request is merged, the task moves to this column. Needs an earlier column that opens it.
flags.release_resources_desc: A task entering this column stops its sandbox and drops its worktree. No column after it can push.
flags.no_skip_desc: The refinement agent and people can't mark this column as skipped for a task. Use it for reviews that must always happen.

locks.initial_move: To change it, make another column the start.
locks.initial_terminal: A finishing column can't be the start.
locks.last_terminal: The board needs at least one finishing column.
locks.terminal_initial: The start column can't also finish work.
locks.terminal_no_advance: A finishing column does not pass the task on.
locks.edge_no_agent: No agent runs in the start or finishing column.
locks.start_no_pr: A task in the start column has no pull request yet.
locks.skip_unless: A column that can be skipped can't ask for approvals, push, open pull requests or free resources.
locks.merge_target_taken: Merged tasks already land in {stage}; a board has one such column.
locks.merge_target_without_pr: No column before this one opens a pull request, so no merged task can land here.
locks.pr_needed_by_merge: Merged tasks land in {stage}, which needs a column before it that opens the pull request.
locks.required_checks_without_pr: An approval here waits for required checks, and no column up to this one opens a pull request.
locks.pr_needed_by_checks: An approval in {stage} waits for required checks and needs a column up to it that opens the pull request.
locks.worktree_after_release: {stage} already freed the worktree, so a later column can't push, open pull requests or lock tests.
locks.release_before_worktree: {stage} comes later and still needs the worktree.
locks.release_kick_back: A column that frees resources can't send changes back.
locks.kick_back_to_skippable: {stage} can be skipped, so it can't receive changes sent back.
locks.skippable_is_kick_back_target: {stage} sends changes back to this column, so it can't be skipped.
locks.kick_back_earlier: Changes go back to an earlier column that does not finish work.
locks.no_skip_skip_unless: This column already runs only for marked tasks. Clear that list first.
locks.skip_unless_no_skip: Tasks can't skip this column. Turn that off first.

delete.title: Delete column {column}?
delete.lost: Its behavior and approvals are deleted with it. This can't be undone.

move.picked_kbd: Picked up {column}, position {position} of {count}. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel.
move.unchanged: The column stayed where it was.
move.cancelled: Move cancelled. The column is back where it was.

warnings.initial_not_first: Tasks start in {stage}, which is not the first column.
warnings.after_terminal: {stage} comes after {terminal}, where work finishes. Tasks that finish never reach it.

errors.generic: The daemon didn't answer. Check your connection and try again.

skip_unless.label: Run only for tasks marked
skip_unless.help: Comma-separated values of the task's flow flags, for example ui, api. Empty runs the column for every task.
skip_unless.invalid: "{value}" is not valid: use lowercase letters, digits and _ (up to 32).
